howto: Press Play once the town has loaded.
Move with WASD, look with the mouse, hold Shift to run, and press E to use things.
Claim a brown plot with E, then build (B), furnish (F) and paint (C) your house.
Work at the blue shop for cash; check the mailbox every day for a gift.
tips: Claim a plot first: building needs a plot of your own.
Every shift at a job promotes you, and higher levels pay more.
The mailbox gift grows with your daily streak, so come back every day.
A gem appears around town each day: find it for a cash reward.
Esc closes the build, furniture and shop panels.

controls.keyboard: WASD move, mouse look, Shift run, Space jump, E interact, B build, F furniture, C paint, J journal, P photo mode, Esc closes panels
controls.touch: Best on a desktop browser: the town needs a keyboard; on a phone you can tap Play, the tutorial and the pause button

difficulty: No difficulty modes: it is a relaxed sandbox where jobs pay more as you are promoted and the daily mailbox gift grows with your streak.

settings.quality: Graphics: High / Low on the title card (Low renders at 1x pixel ratio)

features.autosave: The town saves itself when you buy, claim or collect, and on quit; the save is kept in IndexedDB
features.goals-or-quests: The tutorial's steps (claim a plot, build, work, mailbox) and the daily gem and mailbox streak
features.day-time-ui: Clock and day in the HUD with a day/night cycle
features.inventory: Furniture bought at the shop kiosk waits in your inventory until you place it in furniture mode (F); J opens the journal
features.results: No game over: a sandbox; the HUD shows money and needs
